evidence.original_label: Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment Business, net sales (narrative)
evidence.excerpt: Regarding management performance of semiconductor manufacturing equipment business, investments in China and "Other Asia" region was steady and sales of precision molds for semiconductor manufacturing and TSS (Total Solution Service) increased due to an increase in shipments of equipment and improved customer utilization rates. As a result, total net sales amounted to 48,959 million yen (year-on-year increase of 3,055 million yen, 6.7%).

notes: TOWA's Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment segment, from the 47th-term (FY ended March 2025) Annual Securities Report's own 'Management performance by segment' narrative (whole millions of yen, matches an allowed revenue-metric unit exactly). Precision flagged 'rounded' rather than 'reported': this same filing's formal segment-note table (physical page 97, 'Current consolidated fiscal year ended March 31, 2025') states the identical fact to finer precision as 48,959,043 thousand yen = JPY 48,959.043 million, which truncates to this narrative's 48,959 -- that more precise table figure is NOT independently registered because its unit (thousands of yen) has no corresponding entry among the revenue metric's allowed units (see dataset notes). The same 48,959,043-thousand-yen figure also recurs, unrestated, as the comparative column of the 48th-term (towa_fy2025_asr_eng) Annual Securities Report's segment note (physical page 97) -- i.e. no restatement occurred between the two filings for this year.

evidence.original_label: Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment Business, net sales (narrative)
evidence.excerpt: Regarding operating results of the semiconductor manufacturing equipment business, net sales increased mainly due to higher sales to Taiwan and China regions against the backdrop of increased investment in general-purpose memory, as well as a significant increase in sales of singulation equipment, resulting in net sales of 49,870 million yen (year-on-year increase of 911 million yen, 1.9%).

notes: TOWA's Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment segment, 48th-term (FY ended March 2026) Annual Securities Report 'Operating Results by segment' narrative (whole millions of yen). The same filing's formal segment-note table (physical page 97, current-year column) states the identical fact to finer precision as 49,870,942 thousand yen = JPY 49,870.942 million, not independently registered for the thousands-of-yen unit-gap reason given on TOWA-SME-REV-FY2024. This is the fiscal year in which the same page's narrative attributes a profit decline partly to 'the impact of temporary additional costs associated with initial deliveries of compression equipment' alongside 'a deterioration in the product mix of transfer equipment' -- the clearest textual evidence found in this packet that TOWA tracks transfer and compression as distinct product lines internally, even though no revenue split between them is ever published (see the entity note and this packet's handback report for the full finding).
